decisions.reason: The source explicitly applies only to the Weave Print; the Zebra print has its own colour direction established in message 27 and remains unchanged.
Matching the original colour reference for the Weave Print does not change the independently specified mustard block-colour pareo.
The Weave Print colour adjustment does not alter the terracotta block-colour pareo or its Pantone reference.
The source changes the Weave artwork's colour treatment only; it does not modify production-file standards, printing method, fabric, ICC profile, or the general colour-matching workflow.
